blurb.text: A Benton County AVA around Goose Mountain between Kiona and Richland, within Yakima Valley and Columbia Valley. It is named for a common path of migratory waterfowl. Main grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Merlot and Syrah.
